ideas.title: The Feeding Our Future Fraud: A Deep Dive
ideas.description: Investigate the $250 million child nutrition fraud scheme and the arrest of Abdirizak H in Somalia.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate the individuals and organizations involved in the scheme.
questions: Who were the individuals involved in the scheme?
What were the consequences for those involved?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a significant case of international fraud and highlight the efforts of law enforcement agencies to combat it.
